The A380 arrived when twin-engine efficiency and reliability (ETOPS ratings) were already putting economic pressure on quad-jets. A380 arrived on the market too late. The 747 was only able to squeeze out more production after A380 was discontinued because there was a cargo variant, the same way it survived the economic bumps from 1970-2023.
